[B1] < deviceA | 'buttonPressed' : false , ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceA => < deviceA | 'buttonPressed' : true , ... > .
[B2] < deviceA | 'buttonPressed' : true , 'key' : nils , ... > < cloudA | UserX : ('accountKey' : Key , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'sendKey' deviceA | (Key) => < deviceA | 'buttonPressed' : false , 'key' : Key , ... > < cloudA | UserX : ('accountKey' : Key , ...) , ... > .
[B3] < deviceA | 'key' : Key , ... > $ UserX 'discover' deviceA => < deviceA | 'key' : Key , ... > $ deviceA 'bind' cloudA | (Key) .
[B3] < cloudA | UserY : ('accountKey' : Key , ...) , deviceA : ('owner' : nils , ...) , ... > $ deviceA 'bind' cloudA | (Key) => < cloudA | UserY : ('accountKey' : Key , ...) , deviceA : ('owner' : UserY , ...) , ... > .
[B4] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceA => < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > .
[B5] < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceA => < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
